a: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مَاذَا نُزِّلَ مِنَ التَّشْدِيدِ
m: Glory be to Allah, what severity has been revealed. Then he said: by the One in whose hand is my soul, if a man were killed in the way of Allah, then brought back to life, then killed again, and he owed a debt, he would not enter Paradise until his debt was paid.
